items.title: PPL Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Rates, Sales Volumes
items.summary: PPL beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates on higher rates and sales volumes, while raising its long-term EPS growth target and unveiling a $25B investment plan.

items.title: PPL: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
items.summary: (PPL) on Friday reported third-quarter net income of $367 million.The Allentown, Pennsylvania-based company said it had net income of 49 cents per share.

items.title: PPL (PPL) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: PPL (PPL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.89% and +2.40%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: PPL Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: PPL (NYSE:PPL) is scheduled to report its earnings on Friday, November 6, 2026. The company has a market value of about $26.9 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $9.4 billion in revenue and $2.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.3 billion.
